nodes.label: Mock at System Boundaries Only
nodes.rationale: Mocking only external APIs, databases, time/randomness, and file system (at boundaries) while never mocking your own classes/modules or internal collaborators keeps tests reliable and decoupled from implementation.

nodes.label: SDK-Style Interfaces for Mockability
nodes.rationale: Specific functions per external operation (SDK-style) rather than a generic fetcher allow each mock to return one specific shape, require no conditional logic in test setup, and provide type safety per endpoint.
